summary.name: Strongbox
summary.one_liner: Strongbox is a native iPhone and Mac password manager compatible with the KeePass database format, with cloud, WebDAV and SFTP sync.
use_cases: store passwords on iPhone and Mac
sync password database to own cloud or server
migrate from 1Password or other KeePass clients
summary.what_it_does: Strongbox is a password manager for iPhone, iPad and Mac that uses industry-standard KeePass-compatible databases, so the same file can be opened in other KeePass clients. Users can store databases online or offline, syncing with major cloud storage providers or their own server over WebDAV or SFTP. It audits passwords for duplicates, weak, common and short entries, and checks for data breaches via Have I Been Pwned. It also stores 2FA codes (QR code, RFC 6238 or Steam), SSH keys, and Markdown notes, and includes automated backups and automatic database compare-and-merge.
notable: KeePass-compatible database format with Password Safe support, avoiding vendor lock-in
Face ID / Touch ID unlock and YubiKey hardware token support
SSH agent for generating and storing SSH keys
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page; the listing points to the Mac App Store.
Support is described as premium, but its terms and availability beyond the stated 7-day coverage are not detailed.
